svg.text: Roots Lineage R1 v1.1 — Eight Layers, Two Lineages
Left: the stack. Right: the cash lineage (T-xx) and the identity lineage (T-Ixx) that converge in decentralised identity. Tags match the R1 report.
L7 · APPLICATION / I2I
authenticated, confidential, ordered exchange between two identities
T-I04 TLS 1995→1.3 2018 · T-I06 OTR 2004 · T-I07 Signal X3DH/Double Ratchet 2013–16 · T-I08 Noise 2016
T-I09 JOSE/COSE envelopes 2015/17 · T-I18 DIDComm v2 2022 (O16) · T-I22 A2A / MCP agent protocols
Programme: V2X Tier 1/2 path reads cached L6 state; only Tier-3 writes touch the ledger (HAA-1 read-path rule)
L6 · IDENTITY
key↔subject binding · disclosure · revocation · delegation · recovery
T-I01 Kerberos 1988 · T-I02 X.509/PKI 1988, CT logs 2013 · T-I03 PGP web-of-trust 1991 · T-I05 IEEE 1609.2 / butterfly keys
T-I13 Anonymous credentials — Chaum 1985, U-Prove 2000, Idemix 2002 · T-I16 Namecoin 2011 (Zooko's triangle)
T-I17 W3C DID Core 2022 / VC-DM 2019–25 · T-I20 AnonCreds 2017/23 (O12) · T-I21 LFDT stack (Family E) · T-I22 ERC-8004 (O9)
Programme: IMinimalSSI — Set A (8 DID/key fns) · Set B (+4 credential fns) · Set C (agent extension); O1–O18
L5 · LEDGER SEMANTICS (digital-cash design)
ownership · transfer · global order · no double-spend
T-19 eCash 1982–98 · T-20 Cypherpunks 1992 · T-21 b-money 1998 · T-22 bit gold 1998 · T-16 RPOW 2004 · T-24 double-spend
BITCOIN 2008–09 closes the loop → generalises to state transition with a global order (Ethereum 2015, Besu 2019)
L4 · ECONOMIC / ANTI-ABUSE
cost to participate · incentive to behave
T-14 Dwork–Naor PoW 1992 · T-15 Hashcash 1997 · T-17 BitTorrent tit-for-tat 2001 · T-18 difficulty adjustment 2009
Permissioned variant: validator governance + accountability replaces cost (QBFT validator set; Indy stewards)
L3 · DISTRIBUTED AGREEMENT
one history among distrusting nodes
T-11 Byzantine Generals 1982, FLP 1985 · T-12 PBFT 1999 → QBFT / RBFT · T-03 Sybil 2002 · T-13 Nakamoto consensus 2008
Deterministic finality (QBFT, RBFT) vs probabilistic (PoW) vs economic (PoS) — the settlement spectrum A/B/C
L2 · AUTHENTICATED DATA STRUCTURES
tamper-evident ordering · membership · non-membership
T-08 Merkle trees 1979 · T-09 Haber–Stornetta hash chain 1991 · T-10 chain of blocks · T-I12 accumulators 1993/2002
T-I19 Sidetree batching 2020 · Patricia–Merkle tries (EVM state) · bitstring status lists (Profile SL)
L1 · CRYPTOGRAPHIC PRIMITIVES
ownership · integrity · unforgeability · proof without disclosure
T-04 DH 1976, RSA 1977 · T-06 ECC 1985, ECDSA, secp256k1 · T-07 SHA-256 2001, RIPEMD-160 · T-05 GMR signature security 1988
T-I10 ZKP — GMR 1985, Fiat–Shamir 1986, Schnorr 1989 · T-I11 pairings — BLS 2001, CL 2002/04, BBS+ · T-I15 Pedersen 1991
T-I14 zk-SNARK Groth16 2016, Bulletproofs 2018 · Schnorr sigs (Taproot 2021) · post-quantum FIPS 203–205 (2024, not deployed)
L0 · COMMUNICATION SUBSTRATE
nodes find and reach each other
T-01 TCP/IP 1974/83 · T-02 Napster 1999, Gnutella 2000, BitTorrent 2001, Kademlia 2002 · libp2p/discv5 · V2X DSRC / C-V2X radio
enables ↑ · secured by ↓
Cash lineage
Identity lineage
grey = post-Bitcoin · dot colour = layer
Where the two lineages converge
